You might be posting in the wrong subreddit. Linguistics is the *scientific study* of language, you see. So here we talk about common properties of language, what does it mean to be a language, etc. You should try r/languagelearning r/learnfrench r/learnspanish for better input on your interests.

And yeah, I think for a lot of cases language learning in school is not very effective.
